selection.pageDesc: Select text → pop button/auto; hover = dictionary only. Word→dict card, sentence→MT; junk skipped. Default: pop button.
selection.triggerDesc: Word→dict (ECDICT→Youdao); sentence→MT; pop only confirms pending show
selection.popButtonDesc: Show Translate button after select; click to translate (recommended; double-click works)

selection.hotkeyOnlyDesc: Only Ctrl+Shift+Y (configurable) translates; mouse select does not
selection.minDragHint: Hint only; double-click word (0px drag) still picks. Pure click with no selection does not trigger
selection.excludeProcHint: No auto selection/hover in these processes. Electron→clipboard first; terminals→UIA only (never Ctrl+C)
selection.hotkeyNote: Hotkeys are still on the Hotkeys page. In-browser select/hover is the extension. See docs/REFERENCE_SELECTION_UX.md
selection.hoverDesc: Can run with pop-button: dwell for word, drag for button
selection.hoverEnableHint: Lookup after cursor settles (no Alt). Dict card only; miss skips MT. Off in terminals. Typing closes card. Shares ECDICT→Youdao with pop button.
selection.hoverCjkHint: Off by default: Chinese hover misfires and triggers slow MT. When on, hover also picks CJK; a dictionary miss still returns the machine translation.
selection.ecdictMissing: Local ECDICT not loaded; hover may be empty for local/auto. Place ecdict.db under dictionaries/ or package resources.
selection.hoverTech: Hover is non-invasive UIA. Reads TextPattern/edit only, not window title Name. Miss skips MT. Hover off in terminals by default.
selection.ocrForceDesc: Not screenshot translate — fallback when selection fails
selection.ocrForceEnable: OCR near cursor when selection is empty
selection.ocrForceHint: Only when: (1) drag/double-click yields no UIA/clipboard text; (2) selection hotkey with no selection. Uses a narrow WinRT strip near the cursor. Full page still uses toolbar OCR screenshot.
selection.ocrModHint: Required for hover-image / empty selection pickup; Shift recommended (Mouse Tooltip Translator).
